retrievalProfile.description: A rugged Americana aesthetic featuring a male subject leaning on a classic muscle car against a textured, painterly sky with heavy slab-serif typography.
triggerTerms: country singer leaning on red muscle car
slab serif text over textured blue sky
americana car portrait with distressed background

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium shot of a man in casual denim and plaid leaning against a red vintage car, set in a grassy field under a teal-to-blue textured sky, anchored by bold, horizontal slab-serif lettering.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject leaning against the car hood creates a diagonal line against the horizontal car body
The red of the car provides a high-contrast base for the cool-toned sky
Typography is positioned in the negative space of the sky to balance the subject on the left
The grass in the foreground provides a natural, organic texture that grounds the mechanical subject
coreInvariants: Heavy slab-serif typography with blocky terminals
Vintage muscle car as a primary prop

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is positioned on the far left, occupying the full vertical height of the frame from the waist up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The red muscle car hood acts as the central horizontal anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the subject's face, follows his gaze across the car hood to the bold typography on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Large expanse of textured sky in the upper right quadrant provides room for display text.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the car contrasts with the desaturated, textured tones of the sky and denim.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extra-bold slab serif with square proportions
letterConstructionRules: Heavy, blocky serifs of equal weight to the main strokes
Low contrast between thick and thin strokes
characterSpecificRedesigns: Tight kerning to create a solid block of text
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single heavy weight for maximum impact; no secondary typeface.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab-serif geometry and blunt terminals.
Provides the necessary blocky, industrial feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photo of a man in a plaid sleeveless shirt and jeans leaning on a red 1970s muscle car in a grassy field. The background should be a textured, painterly teal sky with visible brushstroke or watercolor effects.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold, uppercase slab-serif text in the upper right quadrant using a cream color with a very subtle drop shadow.

verificationChecks: Is the text a heavy slab serif?
Is the sky textured rather than a flat gradient?
Is the car a vibrant red?
Is the subject leaning on the car on the left side?

mustAchieve: Balanced composition between subject and text

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the slab serifs are thick and blocky
Verify the sky has a distressed or painterly texture
Check that the subject does not overlap the text
Confirm the red car is the primary midground element
recipe.reuseFormula: Subject (Americana archetype) + Prop (Vintage Vehicle) + Background (Textured Sky) + Typography (Heavy Slab Serif) = Country Album Aesthetic
